## Purpose
The background runs this browser knows about (persisted summaries, so a reload can reattach), plus the per-tab view state of runs and a log-version counter that re-renders views on new events.

## Responsibilities
- **`TrackedRun`:** a `BackgroundRun` plus `seen`.
- **`MAX_TRACKED = 30`.** `capped()` never evicts running runs and drops the oldest finished ones first.
- **`useRunsStore`:**
  - **`upsert(run, {seen})`:** a poll that races a live `run_end` must not put a finished run back to running, so it keeps the earlier non-running status, result and error;
  - patch;
  - `markSeen` (only finished runs);
  - remove;
  - clearFinished.

  It is persisted under the key `background_runs` (version 1), with `partialize` keeping only the `PERSISTED_REQUEST_KEYS` of each request: mode, tool_id, purpose, task, error, comment, failing_input, expected_output, update_workflows.
- **`useRunUiStore`** (not persisted):
  - `focused` counts;
  - `dismissed` and `minimized`;
  - `openRequest`;
  - setFocusCount, dismiss, setMinimized;
  - **`requestOpen`** also un-dismisses;
  - clearOpenRequest.
- **`useRunLogVersion`:** `versions[id]` and `bump(ids)`.

## Key elements
`useRunsStore`, `useRunUiStore`, `useRunLogVersion`, `TrackedRun`.

## Control flow
None.

## Data, state and side effects
localStorage (`background_runs`).

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- **Used by:** `lib/runs/connections`, `useRun`, `synthesis` and the run indicator and notices.

## Error handling and edge cases
None.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **Requests can carry pasted images or attachments,** which are not needed to reattach, so they are slimmed before persisting.
- **The event logs themselves live in `lib/runs/connections`,** in memory, rebuilt by replay.

## How to rebuild this file
Three zustand stores as described.
